title: Changelog - August 2026 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Changelog - August 2026 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000109656 New Features Released a new Advanced Setting, "Auto-Save Drafts". Disabling this setting turns off the automatic draft-saving system for page edits in the Admin. The feature is enabled by default. Released support for push notifications in the Brilliant Directories mobile app . Admins can now receive alerts on their mobile devices — such as payment notifications — that open the corresponding website and screen when tapped. Released a new "Listing Social Meta Image" field in the Admin’s Edit Member form , allowing Admins to set a dedicated social share image for an individual member’s profile page. Added API support for sending member notification emails on demand. A new endpoint sends any member email template to a specific member, and member updates now accept a notification flag that triggers the matching email. Released a separate set of free trial settings for member upgrades on Membership Plans — " Enable Free Trial Period (Plan Changes)", "Number of Free Trial Days (Plan Changes)" and "Free Trial Additional Options (Plan Changes)" — so free trials can now be configured independently for new sign-ups and for upgrades. These settings are available when the Free Trials Add-On is active. Enhancements / Fixes: Updated the "Members Imported / Added / Updated / Deleted Via Admin" webhooks to include the member's Subscription ID and subscription plan name in the payload. Updated the Froala WYSIWYG editor used across the platform to the latest version, improving stability and security. Improved the security of the Member Profile Statistics Add-On by adding stricter validation of tracked click data and safer display of statistics in the Member Dashboard. Fixed an issue that caused auto-saved drafts from one website to be offered on a different website when an Admin managed multiple websites. Fixed an issue that caused the main newsletter editor to close when closing the image upload window while replacing an image in the AI Newsletter Creator in the Admin . Fixed an issue that caused custom web pages to be marked as not indexable by search engines in some cases, even when the page's no-index setting was disabled. Fixed an issue that caused Media Manager entries in the Admin Activity Tracker to be recorded in UTC instead of the website's timezone. Fixed an issue that caused the Transactions tab of a member's profile in the Admin to display invoices belonging to a previously deleted member in some cases. Fixed an issue that allowed Admin users without the Billing History permission to view a member's transaction history from the Payments tab in the Admin if accessed directly. Fixed an issue that caused a website's robots.txt file to be emptied or lose its existing rules when the Enhanced Hosting package was activated in some cases. Fixed an issue that prevented Member Credits from being re-evaluated when collecting on invoices generated prior to a change to the Billing Credit Settings of a site being saved. Fixed an issue that caused category page URLs created through the API or bulk imports to drop non-English characters. Fixed an issue that caused the .htaccess and robots.txt file editors in the Admin to remove backslashes and corrupt special characters when saving. Fixed an issue that prevented creating a subscription starting on the current date when adding a new customer order in the Admin in some cases. Fixed an issue that prevented Stripe credentials from being saved in the Admin in some cases. The system now displays a clear error message and automatically resolves the underlying problem. Fixed an issue that caused the canonical and Open Graph URLs on post category pages to contain malformed characters in some cases. Fixed an issue that prevented SSL certificates from being installed for a site when one of its additional subdomains failed validation. The system now automatically excludes the failing domain and retries the installation. Added delivered and bounced tracking details for addresses that were added as CC and BCC recipients to the Activity column in the Email Outbox . Updated the members API so that changing a member's profile URL now automatically creates a 301 redirect from the old URL to the new one, matching the existing system behavior, with an option to skip the redirect when needed. Improved the widgets API so it now only returns widgets compatible with the current version of the software. Updated the Sub Accounts section of the Member Dashboard to display a "Publish Your First Sub Account" prompt when a member has not created any sub accounts yet. Fixed an issue that allowed emails sent from public website forms to use a visitor-supplied sender name and email address in some cases; these emails now always use the website's own sender information. Fixed an issue that prevented WebP post images from displaying in social media share previews when the Front-End Optimization setting "Use Content Delivery Network (CDN) for Images" is enabled in some cases. Fixed an issue that caused member reviews to display HTML character codes instead of readable text when editing a review in the Admin. Fixed an issue that prevented the Google Map on member profile pages from loading automatically in some cases. Fixed an issue that caused the member search in the Admin to return no results when combining a member tag filter with a photo or logo filter. Fixed an issue that caused the system to write unnecessary debugging information to the website's error log on every page load. Improved the Draft system used when editing pages in the Admin , including a clearly visible "Discard draft" button. Updated the way embedded YouTube videos start on mobile devices so that tapping the video thumbnail now begins playback with sound instead of muted. Desktop playback is unchanged. Improved the mobile rendering of the default email template so that emails display at the correct size and with the correct typography in Apple Mail on iOS, the Gmail mobile app and Outlook. mproved the security of the Categories management page in the Admin by strictly validating every value used to build its database queries. Fixed an issue that caused a member's paid recurring order to remain active and keep billing their card after they switched themselves to a free plan, in cases where the member had more than one product on their billing account. Fixed an issue that caused a member's save in the Member Dashboard to be silently discarded, with no error shown, when a form field had validation enabled and the String Length limits were left blank in the Form Builder. Fixed an issue that caused a previous visitor's claim listing message to keep appearing on the checkout page of a shared device, because the claim listing information was not cleared when logging out or logging in. Fixed an issue that caused every Sub Account listing to display the same favorites count. In addition, fixed an issue that caused a single saved member to mark all of that member's post favorite buttons as already saved on profile pages. Fixed an issue that caused the location search fields on the frontend of sites to use the street number as the ZIP code when a visitor selected an exact street address in the location field. Fixed an issue that caused the Sitemap Generator in the Admin to report that no sitemap exists even after a sitemap was generated successfully, when the website's sitemap contained a single file. Fixed an issue that caused the generated sitemap to include URLs for pages that no longer resolve to a live page in some cases. Fixed an issue that caused the email editor in the Admin to remove the margin spacing applied to images when composing an email or editing an email template. Fixed an issue that caused the Sub Categories section of the API Documentation page in the Admin to display no endpoints, and removed two duplicate empty sections from the same page. Fixed an issue that caused the API to return a success response when updating a Sub Category or Top Category with a field that is not allowed to be modified. The API now returns a clear error naming the field instead. Fixed an issue that caused the API to return a success response when adding or removing a member tag using the tag name instead of its numeric ID, without the tag actually being added or removed. Tag names are now accepted and resolved automatically. Fixed an issue that caused the member update endpoint of the API to store HTML code in member fields without cleaning it, while the member creation endpoint already removed it. Fixed an issue that allowed an Admin User with a restricted role to open an Admin page they were not granted access to by adding an extra parameter to the page URL. Fixed an issue that caused the website's private payment gateway credentials to be recorded in the billing activity log every time a payment was processed. Improved the Draft system used when editing pages in the Admin . New pages no longer conflict with each other, and the draft save error and conflict notifications were removed. Updated the member "Forgot Password" flow so its response messages are now editable text labels, allowing site owners to customize and translate them. Improved lead management by recording a " Lead / Deleted " entry in the Website Activity tracker whenever a lead is deleted from the Admin , in bulk, or through the API . Improved the display of the Default Email Template on mobile devices in Apple Mail, the Gmail app and Outlook. Applied a security update to the Member Categories page in the Admin . Fixed an issue that caused the member upgrade page to navigate to an invalid address when a membership plan was not selected before continuing. Fixed an issue that caused the sitemap to include location pages that no longer exist, so search engines were sent to "Page Not Found" errors. Fixed an issue that caused the frontend search to add the street number to the ZIP code parameter when a member searched for an exact street address. Fixed an issue that caused a member’s paid recurring order to remain active and continue billing after the member downgraded to a free plan in some cases. Fixed an issue that caused an "Add Credit Card" prompt to appear when a member claimed a free digital product on websites using Stripe. Fixed an issue that prevented the reCAPTCHA on the default login form from activating when a member navigated and submitted the form using the keyboard. Fixed an issue that caused a member’s profile URL to be rewritten when the member was updated through the API even though the " If checked, the system will not auto-update this URL when new changes are saved to the member’s name, category or location ." option was enabled. The system now respects that option and keeps the member’s existing filename . Fixed an issue that caused the member tags associated with a member to remain in the database after the member was deleted. Fixed an issue that caused country pages whose name contains a comma, such as "Korea, Republic of", to generate links that led to a "Page Not Found" error. Fixed an issue that caused the " Fetch and Resize " action on Member Images page in the Admin to save a broken profile image URL. Fixed an issue that caused listings added to a site via Business Data Import to display garbled descriptions when written in non-Latin alphabets such as Cyrillic. Fixed an issue that prevented the " Block Traffic by Country " list from being cleared in Admin > Settings > General Settings > Localization, so removing every country and saving is now stored correctly. Fixed an issue that caused certain homepage sections to display at full width when they should not. Fixed an issue that prevented members from saving their profile details on websites with the " In dia Stripe Account Accept International Payments " setting enabled, where a required State/Province check intended only for checkout was also applied to the member profile form. Fixed an issue that caused API responses to be marked as cacheable for 30 days on some servers, which could allow private data to be served again. Fixed an issue that prevented category and sub-category pages with a nested URL path from being created through the API . Improved front-end page loading speed: a JavaScript library that was previously loaded on every page of the website is now loaded only on the pages that actually use it. In all, over 90 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
